                    var encodedPayload = Convert.ToBase64String(payloadBytes).Split('=')[0].Replace('+', '-').Replace('/', '_');

                    string stringToSign = encodedHeader + "." + encodedPayload;

                    // DEFINE YOUR SECRET TEXT KEY HERE (Must be a long string phrase)
                    string secretKey = "YourSuperLongAndSecureSecretKeyThatIsAtLeast256BitsLong!!";

                    // Compute the secure HMACSHA256 signature token stamp
                    byte[] keyBytes = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(secretKey);
                    byte[] messageBytes = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(stringToSign);
                    
                    using (var hmac = new System.Security.Cryptography.HMACSHA256(keyBytes))
                    {
                        byte[] hashBytes = hmac.ComputeHash(messageBytes);
                        var encodedSignature = Convert.ToBase64String(hashBytes).Split('=')[0].Replace('+', '-').Replace('/', '_');
                        
                        // Return the fully compiled, securely signed token: header.payload.signature
                        return stringToSign + "." + encodedSignature;
                    }
